topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by welcoming students and setting out the core focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen Recognition and PRR Signaling Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how the innate immune system senses microbial threats and tissue damage through PAMPs, DAMPs, and various pattern recognition receptor families and complexes.

topics.label: Cellular Activation, Leukocyte Recruitment, and Systemic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sentinel cells initiate local leukocyte trafficking into tissues, lymphatic transit to lymph nodes, and the systemic dangers of excessive inflammatory signaling.

topics.label: Inflammation Resolution, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the active and passive mechanisms that terminate acute inflammation, mediate tissue repair, and give rise to chronic inflammation and granulomas when unresolved.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding closing remarks and previews the topic of the next lecture.
